title: Genie 4 is now available on the Gemini API.

claims.claim: Genie 4 is now available for developers through the Gemini API and Google AI Studio.

evidence.quote: Genie 4 is now available for developers through the Gemini API (via the Interactions API) and Google AI Studio.

claims.claim: Developers can generate continuous 720p worlds at 24fps with synchronized native audio starting from a text prompt, a reference image, or both.

evidence.quote: Starting from a text prompt, a reference image, or both, developers can experiment with generating continuous 720p worlds at 24fps with synchronized native audio

claims.claim: Users can use real-time keyboard controls alongside live text prompts to navigate environments and change weather, lighting, objects, or events on the fly.

evidence.quote: Using real-time keyboard controls alongside live text prompts, you can navigate environments and change weather, lighting, objects, or events on the fly.

claims.claim: Gemini reasoning keeps the world state consistent and coherent throughout.

evidence.quote: Gemini reasoning keeps the world state consistent and coherent throughout.

claims.claim: Every output includes imperceptible SynthID watermarking.

evidence.quote: As a reminder every output includes imperceptible SynthID watermarking.
